embeds.title: FRANCHISE SEEKING AN OWNER
embeds.description: **`[FRANCHISE]`** is open and the league is looking for a replacement owner.

fields.name: WHAT HAPPENS NOW
fields.value: The franchise is locked from transactions while a replacement is arranged. The Commissioner keeps the roster legal (Article XVIII).

fields.name: PREPAID DUES
fields.value: Any prepaid future seasons stay with the franchise and transfer to the new owner.

fields.name: INTERESTED?
fields.value: Contact the Commissioner. Please send names of qualified candidates.
